name: Gusto
summary: The sandbox is self-serve, but production access is gated and not all applications are approved. Gusto does not publish how long it takes.

gates.title: Create a developer account and sandbox app
gates.nextStep: Create a developer account and an app in Gusto's developer portal; use the sandbox (api.gusto-demo.com) with the redirect URI Composio shows when you create a custom auth config.

gates.title: Production Pre-Approval application (includes security review)

blockers.fix: Production access is gated; ask Gusto what is missing before reapplying.

gates.nextStep: Submit the Production Pre-Approval application, including the security review. Not all applications are approved.
gates.whatToAsk: Email developer@gusto.com: "What is the current timeline for pre-approval and the security review?"

gates.title: Send the Partner Checklist to developer@gusto.com
gates.nextStep: Email the completed Partner Checklist to developer@gusto.com.

gates.title: QA review, then production keys
gates.nextStep: Book the QA review Gusto asks for; production keys follow approval.
gates.whatToAsk: Ask developer@gusto.com: "How long does QA review take before production keys are issued?"

claims.text: Create a developer portal account, org and app to get a client ID; the sandbox is api.gusto-demo.com only.

sources.quote: Dev portal → org → app → client ID; sandbox api.gusto-demo.com only.

claims.text: Production needs Pre-Approval, then the Partner Checklist, then QA review before production keys. Not all applications are approved.

sources.quote: Production access is gated, and not all applications are approved

claims.text: Gusto does not publish approval durations; third-party reports of the security review differ: about 1 week (Merge) vs 2–4 weeks (Finch).
claims.note: Third-party reports, not Gusto; the wait is modelled as unknown.
